title: Inner-ear CT specimen 1 · fluid-space anatomy
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Inspect complete source sections and linked source-label surfaces for cochlear, vestibular and canal fluid spaces, while retaining source sampling and definition limits.

scenes.title: Cochlea fluid space · context
scenes.prompt: Follow the cochlear fluid-space label through adjacent CT sections and compare its coiled source surface with the vestibular label.
scenes.note: Original Dataset A cadaveric specimen 1; separate from clinical Dataset B. The label describes the inner-ear fluid-space annotation, not a separately segmented nerve, sensory epithelium or membranous labyrinth. The source file does not explicitly declare specimen laterality; coordinate offset is not used to infer a side. Reconstructed sampling is about 0.0986 mm; the publication reports acquired slice thickness of 0.466 mm. Sampling is not a claim of isotropic acquired resolution. The three separately supplied landmark records have unresolved IJK-to-LPS residuals and are not integrated as verified teaching targets. CT intensity: original integer values; no calibration inferred.
